What they do

About Afrikan Crown

Afrikan Crown brings Rasta-inspired clothing to the market village: flowing trance dresses, reggae-print tees and vests, tie-dye and embroidered tunics carrying icons like Bob Marley and Haile Selassie.

Alongside the clothing rail sits a full spread of Rasta items and smoking accessories — rolling papers, grinders, pipes and bongs in every colour.
